title: Simple Sentences
description: Begin typing complete sentences with spaces.

exercises.text: the cat sat on the mat.
she likes to read books.
we go to school every day.
he works hard at his job.
they play games after class.

reviewMaterial: Space separates words. End each sentence with a period.

title: Sentence Rhythm
description: Build smooth rhythm across full sentences.

exercises.text: practice makes progress when you type each day.
keep your eyes on the screen and not on the keys.
good posture helps you type longer without strain.
start slow and focus on accuracy before speed.
every keystroke builds muscle memory over time.

reviewMaterial: Maintain even timing from the first word to the last.

title: Questions and Answers

exercises.text: what time is the meeting today?
where did you put the report?
how can i improve my typing speed?
who will join us for the review?
why does practice matter so much?

reviewMaterial: Question marks use Shift + /. Practice the reach.

title: Descriptive Sentences
description: Add detail with adjectives and adverbs.

exercises.text: the bright sun shone through the clear window.
a quiet student typed carefully at the desk.
strong habits form when practice is consistent.
the long document required careful attention.
she finished the difficult task with great skill.

title: Connected Ideas
description: Sentences that link ideas with connectors.

exercises.text: she studied hard and she passed the test.
he wanted to rest but he had more work to do.
we can start now or we can wait until later.
if you practice daily then you will improve.
although it was late they continued typing.

title: Everyday Scenarios
description: Sentences from daily life and work.

exercises.text: please send the file before the end of the day.
the train arrives at the station at noon.
i need to buy milk bread and eggs at the store.
our team meets every monday morning at nine.
thank you for your help with the project.

reviewMaterial: Real-life content prepares you for practical typing.

title: Punctuation Basics
description: Introduce commas and periods in context.

exercises.text: yes, i can help you with that task.
first, open the document. then, edit the text.
she bought apples, oranges, and bananas.
however, the results were better than expected.
after lunch, we will review the notes.

reviewMaterial: Commas pause the reader. Periods end complete thoughts.

title: Mixed Sentence Practice

exercises.text: typing is a skill that improves with steady practice.
when the hands know the keys the mind can focus on ideas.
accuracy first. speed follows natural improvement.
a calm mind and relaxed hands produce better results.
set a small goal each day and celebrate small wins.

reviewMaterial: Variety keeps practice engaging and effective.

title: Paragraph Introduction

exercises.text: learning to type well takes time and patience. start with accuracy. speed will come as your fingers learn the patterns.
the home row is the foundation of touch typing. keep your fingers resting there. return to home after every reach.
good posture supports long practice sessions. sit upright with feet flat. keep wrists level and shoulders relaxed.

reviewMaterial: Paragraphs train sustained focus across multiple sentences.

title: Sentences Review
description: Review sentence skills before Shift training.

exercises.text: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
practice daily and track your progress over time.
when you make a mistake, correct it and continue.
clear goals help you stay motivated during training.
typing mastery grows from consistent small efforts.

reviewMaterial: You are ready to add capital letters with the Shift keys.
